standard_title: Indian Roads Congress Guidelines for Bridge Inspection (Section 4: Bearings and Substations)
trigger_condition: Differential settlement of piers exceeding 20 mm or angular tilt detected in foundation.
inspection_protocol: Immediate visual inspection of elastomeric/pot bearings for shearing, bulging, or unseating. Verify clearance at expansion joints. Deploy level surveying to track 48-hour settlement velocity.
corrective_actions: Enforce immediate 30 km/h traffic speed limit and axle-load restrictions. If settlement exceeds 40 mm, prepare hydraulic jacking rigs for temporary pier shoring.

standard_title: Indian Roads Congress Guidelines for Bridge Inspection (Section 7: Concrete Superstructure & Prestressed Girders)
trigger_condition: Spalling of concrete cover exceeding 5 m² or exposed prestressing tendons.
inspection_protocol: Sound concrete with hammer sounding to map delaminated zones. Inspect exposed prestressing strands for pitting corrosion, wire snap, or carbonation depth.
corrective_actions: Erect protective debris netting underneath to prevent falling spall hazard. Clean exposed steel with rust converters and apply polymer-modified structural mortar repair.

standard_title: Federal Highway Administration Bridge Inspector's Manual (Chapter 10: Dynamic Modal Deviations & Tendon Integrity)
trigger_condition: Fundamental vertical bending frequency drops by more than 8% from historical baseline.
inspection_protocol: Execute non-destructive ultrasonic impact-echo testing on post-tensioning ducts to assess tendon grouting voids and strand continuity. Verify mid-span dead-load sag profile.
corrective_actions: Reduce bridge live-load capacity rating by 25%. Place continuous dynamic acoustic emission sensors to monitor ongoing tendon strand fractures.

standard_title: Indian Roads Congress Guidelines for Bridge Inspection (Section 9: Abutments and Geotechnical Hazards)
trigger_condition: Abutment displacement, backfill movement, or landslide pressure against wing walls.
inspection_protocol: Inspect abutment walls for shear cracking, weep hole drainage blockage, and toe scouring. Measure gap variations at expansion fingers.
corrective_actions: Clear drainage channels, clear toe debris, and install soil nailing / micropiles if active slope displacement is observed.
